poll.source_locator: HMP release 'For Immediate Release Thursday, August 5, 2026 ... conducted by Global Strategy Group from July 14-19 ... James leads Mitchell 46% to 45%'; generic ballot tied 45-45
poll.notes: out_of_window (field end Jul 19); written because no IA-02 poll with fieldwork on/after Sep 1 is verifiable from a free source (Emerson/Poll Vault Oct 12-14 James 50 Mitchell 47 is paywalled; see README). Release gives no n, population, MoE or mode (Wikipedia lists undecided 9; not used). Open seat; nominees Lindsay James (D) and Joe Mitchell (R).
